campaign_logline: A broke pilot gets entangled in a jurisdictional dispute over salvage rights and questionable debts.
opening_situation: The player's ship is running on fumes, with one Reaver-class hostile visible at the edge of their immediate jump vector.
main_mystery: Unraveling who actually owns the valuable, contested assets floating between Zenith, Aurelia, and Vanguard.
act_1_outline: A minor salvage job goes sour when corporate claims conflict with local law.
Kaelen offers a seemingly simple retrieval contract that proves too complicated.
The player must navigate disputed docking fees to keep their ship operational enough for the next jump.
long_term_reveal: The primary asset dispute is actually cover for a coordinated effort to seize control of regional trade manifests through debt accumulation.
tone: Gritty resource management with bad corporate etiquette.
core_pressure: Maintaining sufficient credits and reputation to operate legally between three conflicting powers.

factions.zenith: Zenith's overzealous adherence to outdated salvage law is crippling local independent operations.
factions.aurelia: Aurelia’s resource taxation system is predatory, bleeding small operators dry through bureaucracy.
factions.vanguard: Vanguard is openly engaging in industrial espionage disguised as border security sweeps.

kaelen_rule: Kaelen operates exclusively out of a neutral-zone brokerage office or bar front.
kaelen_angle: She possesses the actual, untraceable ledger detailing every disputed asset and debt owed by all three major powers.
kaelen_hint_plan: She always asks about local commodity futures before discussing cargo manifests.
Her preferred brand of ration synth is suspiciously rare in this region.
She seems overly concerned with proper documentation formatting for minor transactions.
She never makes eye contact when mentioning the names of high-ranking officials from any faction.
kaelen_hint_style: Overly precise details regarding obscure legal precedents and paperwork minutiae.
kaelen_never_reveal: The true nature of her initial funding or why she established a presence in this specific nexus point.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are revealed when the player jumps through a gate into a system that has not been previously associated with Zenith, Aurelia, or Vanguard jurisdiction.
humor_rule: Humor should derive from bureaucratic incompetence, petty greed, and low-grade mechanical failure.
address_rule: NPCs address the player as "Pilot" or by their ship's registered callsign if known.
fallback_rule: If a required element is missing, assume it relates to minor equipment malfunction or negligible local wildlife hazard until more data appears.
story_horizon_rule: New horizons should introduce new types of contested goods (e.g., specific bio-matter, exotic fuel isotopes) and unique jurisdictional challenges related to those goods.

story_arcs.name: The Manifest Dispute
story_arcs.summary: The player gets dragged into a multi-party fight over the ownership rights to valuable salvaged materials trapped in disputed territory.

rumor_trails.name: The Black Box Claims
rumor_trails.hint_theme: Unaccounted for, high-value corporate data or physical property passing through the sector.
clue_templates: A corrupted data slate mentioning a transfer authorization code that doesn't match known registries.
Finding discarded security logs detailing unauthorized personnel access to a restricted vault area.
rumor_trails.payoff: A single, high-value contract granting temporary immunity from one of the three major factions' fees.

regeneration_triggers.description: When the main story arc is resolved, trigger the next major thread of mystery via a new rumor trail.

expansion_rules: Introduce entirely new economic resource types that require specialized processing technology not available in current systems.
Establish a minor non-aligned governmental body whose charter conflicts with all three existing powers.
